spectrumPanel.title: On-the-fly spectrum
spectrumPanel.intro: Measures the target's flux in exposures from the six SPHEREx detectors and sorts it by wavelength. This is relative spectrophotometry, without aperture correction.
spectrumPanel.cancelled: You stopped waiting for this measurement.
spectrumPanel.noPoints: There are no usable measurements for this position.
spectrumPanel.caption: Relative spectrophotometry, without aperture correction.
spectrumPanel.plotTitle: Relative spectrophotometry of {count, plural, one {# measurement} other {# measurements}}
spectrumPanel.plotDesc: {count, plural, one {# measurement} other {# measurements}} between {min} and {max} microns, on {dates, plural, one {# date} other {# dates}}.

lightCurve.title: Light curve
lightCurve.absoluteWarning: Absolute flux: not corrected for common changes. A brightness change here may come from the instrument.
lightCurve.notDetected: The target is not detected separately in each frame: the curve mostly reflects noise. For faint objects, use the stack.
lightCurve.notDetectedSnr: The target is not detected separately in each frame (median SNR {snr}): the curve mostly reflects noise. For faint objects, use the stack.
lightCurve.summary: {used} of {total} epochs with a measurement. Minimum {min}, maximum {max}, amplitude {amp} {method, select, psf {(relative amplitude of the PSF wings, normalized to the median)} relative {(relative flux, normalized to the median)} other {(absolute flux)}}.
lightCurve.noUsable: No epoch has a usable measurement.
lightCurve.plotTitle: Light curve of {count, plural, one {# epoch} other {# epochs}}
lightCurve.axisY: {method, select, psf {relative amplitude of the PSF wings} relative {relative flux} other {absolute flux}}
lightCurve.legendScatter: reference noise (±{scatter}, {count, plural, one {# comparison star} other {# comparison stars}})
lightCurve.legendUnused: no usable measurement (flag or outside coverage): frames {frames}

neossatPanel.loading: Asking the Canadian Astronomy Data Centre (CADC)…
neossatPanel.error: CADC (NEOSSat archive) could not be reached. The SPHEREx sequence is not affected.
neossatPanel.found: {count, plural, one {# NEOSSat observation} other {# NEOSSat observations}} within {radius}° of this position, from {first} to {last}.
neossatPanel.none: NEOSSat never pointed within {radius}° of this position.
neossatPanel.context: NEOSSat is the Canadian Space Agency's optical telescope for asteroids and space debris. It only observes the fields it is aimed at, so its images are independent extra epochs, not SPHEREx frames.
neossatPanel.open: Open the NEOSSat collection at CADC
